_comment: Copy this file to .claude/mcp.json in your workspace root. Atlassian is the official remote MCP server (https://www.atlassian.com/platform/remote-mcp-server) — no static token needed, it authenticates via OAuth on first use (run /mcp in Claude Code and follow the browser prompt). GitHub and Playwright are local npx servers; set their credentials in ~/.claude/.env or your shell profile. Optional servers: Linear (npx @linear/mcp), SonarQube, Filesystem (npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem).
